description.p: This is a community package of Antigravity IDE, maintained independently and unaffiliated with Google. It repackages Google's official Linux tarball unmodified.

Antigravity IDE is Google's fully-featured, agentic IDE with a deep understanding of your codebase. It enables you to manage and run local AI coding agents in parallel, edit code, and navigate project files.
A Google account is required for the agent features; the app itself is free to install.

Permissions: by default this package grants home directory access, because the agents work on your project files. A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Host command execution: flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak com.google.AntigravityIDE
Host SSH keys: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.ssh:ro com.google.AntigravityIDE

description.p: Because home access is granted, Antigravity IDE keeps its own state under your real home directory (~/.gemini) rather than inside the sandboxed app data directory, so that state is left behind by flatpak uninstall --delete-data and has to be removed by hand.
